tasks.description: T-C2: the single most informative measurement still missing in this entire thread, and the only way the current standstill can be broken, is the per-stage slack vector at a CONVERGED iterate at production tolerances. Every existing slack number in this project comes from a solve truncated at one iteration, because all four v34u cells were constructed with effective ipopt.max_iter=1 and returned Maximum_Iterations_Exceeded / SOLVER_RET_LIMITED. Within-cell objective reconstruction is therefore verified and should not be re-litigated. What is NOT established is whether converged optimal slack is zero or positive. This is discriminating and cheap: if converged slack is negligible, the omitted-slack mechanism is confined to truncated iterates and stops constraining deployed-behaviour explanations, and the terminal-opportunity question T-C4 becomes the natural next science; if converged slack is materially positive, the amended reconstruction is permanently required for any converged-objective claim and the objective-contract thread closes as a verified IMPROVED formula amendment with a live methodological consequence. Frozen inputs: opened development context source242_slot0_branch_start ONLY, term_mode V15_shared, goal case.tvp.trajectory_endpoint[61], cells H12/H15/H35 canonical plus H15 goal_facing. IPOPT at PRODUCTION tolerances (max_iter NOT forced to 1) for all four cells, plus EXACTLY ONE forced max_iter=1 truncated control, and that control must be the H12 cell only. Five scheduled low-level solver calls against an existing six-call ceiling. Required per-cell outputs: return_status and unified_return_status, actual iteration count, J_solver, J_recon_historical_noeps, J_recon_full, both relative errors against the predeclared thresholds, direct NLP f evaluated at opt_x_num/opt_p_num compared to opt_f_num, the PERSISTED PER-STAGE EPSILON VECTOR for all k and all j WITH ITS LABEL AND DIMENSION, eps_nonzero_count, per-stage gamma^k*1000*epsilon contributions, the soft-margin quantity 1.5*r_obstacle - d, hard obstacle clearance, and an explicit verdict on whether any epsilon is materially non-zero at convergence. Also report solver_wall_s and whole_decision_get_action_wall_s as mean/median/P95 with n, and state that no truncated cell's timing is a deployable estimate. Predeclared acceptance: converged full-objective relative error <= 1e-6; the H35 1e-5 allowance applies only if H35 is documented non-converged before the run; any converged cell above 1e-4 is a hard defect that stops the task. Branch rules: all four cells converge with relative error <= 1e-6 -> close OC-epsilon-1 as a verified IMPROVED formula amendment, release dependent contract-consumer work, and state the converged-slack verdict either way, because positive converged slack falsifies only the universal zero-slack hypothesis and is NOT a defect; converged miss in 1e-6 to 1e-4 -> record as a SECOND distinct residual source under a new stable ID and do not proceed; any converged cell above 1e-4 -> hard defect, stop, escalate to lead. Negative and null results are first-class outputs and must be preserved verbatim. No plant steps, no env.step/reset after construction, no training, no refit, no validation64, no sealed test.
